description: YojanaBench QA benchmark - human-verified question/answer pairs across eligibility, entitlement, documents and appeal categories, including counterfactual and edge-case variants. Amounts are simplified/illustrative for the benchmark demo (see docs/DATASET_README.md).

items.question: A rural household in Bihar holds an Antyodaya (AAY) ration card and no member pays income tax. Is the household eligible for foodgrains under PDS?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. An AAY household resident in the state and not an income-tax payer qualifies under the National Food Security Act.

items.question: How many kg of foodgrains per month is an Antyodaya (AAY) household entitled to?
items.reference_answer: 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month.

items.question: A Priority Household (PHH) with a family of 5 - how much foodgrain is it entitled to per month?
items.reference_answer: 25 kg per month (5 kg per person x 5 members).

items.question: An AAY household where one member is an income-tax payer - are they still eligible for PDS?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. Income-tax payers are excluded from Priority Household coverage under the Act.

items.question: Which documents must accompany a new PDS ration card application?
items.reference_answer: Ration Card, Aadhaar Card and Residence/Address Proof.

items.question: An AAY household meets all eligibility criteria but has not submitted its ration card. What is the correct verdict?
items.reference_answer: Needs information - the mandatory Ration Card is missing, so eligibility cannot be confirmed yet.

items.question: A 65-year-old person from a BPL household - eligible for old age pension?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The applicant is 60+ years and belongs to a BPL household.

items.question: How much monthly pension does a 65-year-old BPL beneficiary receive under IGNOAPS?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 200 per month.

items.question: How much monthly pension does an 82-year-old BPL beneficiary receive under IGNOAPS?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 500 per month (enhanced rate for 80+ years).

items.question: A 58-year-old BPL person applies for old age pension. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The applicant is below the minimum age of 60 years.

items.question: A BPL person is exactly 79 years old. What pension amount applies?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 200 per month - the enhanced Rs. 500 rate applies only from age 80.

items.question: A BPL person aged 79 applies; the pension is otherwise admissible but the bank passbook is missing. Verdict?
items.reference_answer: Needs information - the mandatory bank passbook is missing.

items.question: An old age pension application is rejected at the Block level. What is the next appeal authority and the time limit?
items.reference_answer: The first appeal lies with the District Social Welfare Officer within 60 days, and thereafter with the State Social Welfare Commission within 90 days.

items.question: A 45-year-old widow from a BPL household - eligible for widow pension?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. She is a widow aged 40+ and belongs to a BPL household.

items.question: How much monthly pension does a 45-year-old BPL widow receive?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 300 per month.

items.question: A 45-year-old married woman from a BPL household applies for widow pension. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The applicant is not a widow, which is a mandatory criterion.

items.question: A 35-year-old widow from a BPL household applies. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The applicant is below the minimum age of 40 years.

items.question: How much monthly pension does an 85-year-old BPL widow receive?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 500 per month (enhanced rate for 80+ years).

items.question: A widow pension claim is rejected at the Block level. Where should the applicant appeal first and within what time?
items.reference_answer: The first appeal lies with the District Social Welfare Officer within 60 days; a further appeal lies with the State Social Welfare Commission within 90 days.

items.question: A 30-year-old with 85% disability from a BPL household - eligible for disability pension?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. Disability is 80% or more, age is 18+ and the household is BPL.

items.question: How much monthly pension does a 30-year-old with 85% disability receive?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 300 per month.

items.question: A 30-year-old with 60% disability from a BPL household applies. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. Disability must be 80% or more.

items.question: How much monthly pension does an 82-year-old with 90% disability receive?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 500 per month (enhanced rate for 80+ years).

items.question: Which documents are required for the disability pension scheme?
items.reference_answer: Disability Certificate (80%+), BPL Card, Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Passbook.

items.question: A small landholding farmer who is not an income-tax payer - eligible for PM-KISAN?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The applicant is a landholding farmer, not an institutional landholder and not an income-tax payer.

items.question: How much does an eligible farmer family receive under PM-KISAN per instalment and per year?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 2,000 per instalment, three times a year - Rs. 6,000 per year.

items.question: A landholding farmer who pays income tax applies for PM-KISAN. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. Income-tax payers are excluded from the scheme.

items.question: A non-farmer applies for PM-KISAN. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The applicant is not a landholding farmer family.

items.question: A PM-KISAN application is rejected. Where should the farmer escalate the grievance?
items.reference_answer: The grievance lies first with the District Agriculture Officer within 30 days, and can be escalated to the State Nodal Officer (PM-KISAN) within 60 days.

items.question: An SC student pursuing an undergraduate course, parental income Rs. 2,00,000, staying in a hostel - eligible for post-matric scholarship?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The student is SC, at post-matric level and parental income is within the Rs. 2,50,000 ceiling.

items.question: How much annual scholarship does an SC hosteller (parental income Rs. 2 lakh) receive under the post-matric scheme?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 13,500 per year (hosteller maintenance allowance including book grant).

items.question: How much annual scholarship does an SC day-scholar (parental income Rs. 2 lakh) receive under the post-matric scheme?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 7,500 per year (day-scholar maintenance allowance including book grant).

items.question: An SC student with parental income Rs. 3,00,000 applies for post-matric scholarship. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. Parental income exceeds the Rs. 2,50,000 ceiling.

items.question: A General category student applies for the SC post-matric scholarship. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The scheme is restricted to Scheduled Caste students.

items.question: An eligible SC student has not submitted the caste certificate. What is the verdict?
items.reference_answer: Needs information - the mandatory caste certificate is missing.

items.question: Which certificates must accompany a post-matric SC scholarship application?
items.reference_answer: Caste Certificate (SC), Income Certificate, Class 10 Marksheet and Fee Receipt / Admission Proof.

items.question: A 30-year-old adult in a rural household wants to do manual work - eligible for MGNREGA employment?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The applicant is an adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.

items.question: How much wage can a rural household earn under MGNREGA in a year at Rs. 221/day for the full guaranteed period?
items.reference_answer: 100 days x Rs. 221 = Rs. 22,100 per year.

items.question: An urban household applies for MGNREGA employment. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. MGNREGA applies to rural households only.

items.question: A 16-year-old in a rural household applies for MGNREGA work. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. Only adults aged 18 years or older are eligible.

items.question: A BPL rural family of 6 applies for Ayushman Bharat. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The family is an eligible BPL household and there is no cap on family size.

items.question: What is the annual health cover provided to an eligible family under Ayushman Bharat?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.

items.question: A family that is not in the SECC eligibility list applies for Ayushman Bharat. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The family is not identified as an eligible household under SECC criteria.

items.question: Which documents are needed to avail Ayushman Bharat benefits?
items.reference_answer: Ayushman Card / SECC eligibility proof and Aadhaar Card are required; a Ration Card is optional.

items.question: A rural household living in a kutcha house, listed in SECC and not owning a pucca house - eligible for PMAY-G?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The household is houseless/kutcha, does not own a pucca house and is SECC-listed.

items.question: How much housing assistance does an eligible plain-area rural household receive under PMAY-G?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 1,20,000 per unit in plain areas.

items.question: A rural household that already owns a pucca house applies for PMAY-G. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The household owns a pucca house, which is a mandatory exclusion.

items.question: A rural kutcha-house household not included in the SECC list applies for PMAY-G. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The household is not SECC-listed (or Gram Sabha verified).

items.question: An ST student in Class 9 with parental income Rs. 1,00,000 - eligible for pre-matric scholarship?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The student is ST, in Class 9 and parental income is within the Rs. 2,50,000 ceiling.

items.question: How much annual allowance does an ST day-scholar in Class 9 (income Rs. 1 lakh) receive under the pre-matric scheme?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 7,000 per year including ad-hoc grant (day scholar).

items.question: How much annual allowance does an ST hosteller in Class 10 (income Rs. 1 lakh) receive under the pre-matric scheme?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 3,500 per year (hosteller maintenance allowance) plus fee reimbursement.

items.question: An SC student in Class 11 applies for the pre-matric scholarship. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The pre-matric scheme covers only Classes 9 and 10.

items.question: A General category Class 9 student applies for the pre-matric scholarship. Eligible?
items.reference_answer: Ineligible. The scheme is restricted to SC/ST students.

items.question: A BPL person turns exactly 80 years old this year. Which pension rate applies?
items.reference_answer: Rs. 500 per month - the enhanced rate applies from age 80 (boundary inclusive).

items.question: An SC student's parental income is exactly Rs. 2,50,000. Is the student eligible for post-matric scholarship?
items.reference_answer: Eligible. The ceiling is income not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000, so the boundary value is included.

items.question: A 65-year-old BPL widow is eligible for both the old-age pension and the widow pension. What should the audit report?
items.reference_answer: Both schemes are applicable - the applicant qualifies for IGNOAPS and IGNWPS; overlapping entitlements must be flagged for the officer.

items.question: Which documents must accompany a Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme application?
items.reference_answer: Required documents: Disability Certificate (80% or more), Age Proof (Birth Certificate/School Certificate), BPL Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Passbook

items.question: What is the appeal procedure for a rejected Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme application?
items.reference_answer: Appeal procedure: Level 1: Block Development Officer (BDO) within 30 days; Level 2: District Social Welfare Officer within 60 days; Level 3: State Social Welfare Commission within 90 days

items.question: Which documents must accompany a Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme application?
